goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented bounded, fixed-argv Codex/Claude read-only bridge with CLI, HTTP, and typed MCP operations. Receipts capture executable/version, timing, status, bounded output, structured agent evidence, and exact production receipt digest. Unsafe paths, unsupported agents, missing/failed CLIs, oversized output, and digest mismatches are covered by tests. Agent output cannot mutate production state.
